# Antonio Saucedo — Software Engineer

> Portfolio of Antonio Saucedo, a full stack developer based in Rigby, Idaho, with 3+ years of experience building web applications from front-end UI through back-end APIs and database design. Open to full-time and contract roles, available immediately.

Skills include JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, Node.js (Express/NestJS), Python, SQL (Oracle APEX, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and MongoDB, plus team leadership, mentoring and stakeholder communication. B.S. in Software Engineering from Brigham Young University–Idaho (2023).
